### Concrete Findings & Blockers

#### 1. False Controls & Pipeline Disconnects (Blockers)
- **Nether / Bastion observation is entirely absent**: In [run_variant_controls.py](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/run_variant_controls.py#L32), nether requests pass `volume=None`. In [variant_observer.js](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/variant_observer.js#L26-L32), the observer only samples a single dummy block coordinate per chunk at `y=63` and never queries entities, tile entities, containers, or loot tables. In [recognize_variants.py](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/recognize_variants.py#L52), `from_report()` discards records where `volume=None`. Hence `bastion(entities)` is never fed data from BDS runs.
- **Observer script mounting failure**: `shutil.copyfile(..., directory/'observer.js')` writes to `directory`, while Docker binds only `work` (`directory/'world'`) to `/audit`. Even if mounted, BDS does not execute loose root scripts; Script API requires a behavior pack manifest and module structure.
- **Overworld negative Y truncation**: [requests()](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/run_variant_controls.py#L29) clamps volume vertical bounds to `[0, 112]`. Modern Bedrock overworld depth extends to `Y=-64`. Igloo basements generating below `Y=0` are omitted, causing `connected` to fail and `igloo()` to yield false `None` (UNKNOWN).
- **Locate offset clipping**: While `run()` queries `/locate` and verifies `actual` is within 16 blocks of `case['start']`, [requests()](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/run_variant_controls.py#L26) slices are hardcoded around `case['start']`. Any legitimate offset (up to 16 blocks) truncates the 9×9 structure, breaking exact rigid template matching in [match_template()](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/recognize_variants.py#L27).

#### 2. Cap, Budget & Concurrency Errors
- **Active lock bricking**: If `mod.prepare()` or Docker setup fails before entering `run()`'s `try` block, `ledger['active']` is never cleared in [BDS_BUDGET.json](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/run_variant_controls.py#L120), permanently bricking future runs with `Budget identity/active/attempted conflict`.
- **I/O saturation in polling**: In [wait_for()](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/run_variant_controls.py#L65), `size()` recursively stats the entire `OUTPUT` directory tree every 200ms. As LevelDB accumulates thousands of world files, this causes severe CPU/disk thrashing.
- **Budget timeout contradiction**: Cumulative timeouts inside `run()` total ~299s (75s identity + 15s locate + 8×25s observation + save queries), but max `wall` reservation is 180s and `deadline = started + wall - 12` (168s). Valid slower runs will abort prematurely.
- **Premature shutdown kill**: [run()](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/run_variant_controls.py#L98) allows only 5 seconds for `stop`. BDS world saves routinely take 6–10s, triggering false `clean_shutdown = False` failures.

#### 3. Game Identity & Signature Bugs
- **64-bit seed truncation in JS**: `world.seed` in `@minecraft/server` serialized via `JSON.stringify` into standard JS double precision truncates 64-bit integer seeds, causing `identity['seed'] != case['seed']` to reject valid runs.
- **Bastion Units subtype omission**: While `bastion_other` is intentionally ignored, Bastion Units structures only contain `bastion_other` chests. Unlike bridge/hoglin variants, units remnants generate no negative signals, leaving them misclassified as `None`.
- **1-tick generation race**: [variant_observer.js](file:///Users/lucasraicu/.local/share/antigravity-worker-mcp/state/jobs/7b64ddc0d696/workspace/reviews/variant-controls-and-organization-2026-10-22/variant_observer.js#L24) waits only one tick after creating a ticking area before calling `block()`. BDS asynchronous chunk generation routinely requires multiple ticks, risking `Unavailable block` errors.
